exposure: first-trimester two-hour postprandial blood glucose (PPBG) > 110 mg/dL
cohort: 200 pregnant women were enrolled between 8 and 10 weeks of gestation.
finding: First-trimester two-hour postprandial blood glucose (PPBG) > 110 mg/dL exhibits high diagnostic accuracy for predicting GDM and is associated with adverse fetomaternal outcomes.
mod_finding: Women with first-trimester PPBS > 110 mg/dL had significantly higher rates of cesarean section.
gest_age: Participants were enrolled between 8 and 10 weeks of gestation, and preterm delivery was an observed outcome.
